helpIntro: Something went wrong? Check startup requirements or copy details for a bug report.

runtimeCloseFirst: Close WuWa and its injector before changing this setting.

webOpened: Developer tools opened in your default browser. This launcher stays available.
requestSent: Request sent. Waiting for the result…
recordDefaults: Start with automatic capture, clean video, 30 fps and 1024 px per eye. Change these in Recording options.
resetConfirm: Replace the active build’s saved settings with its supplied defaults? Your current settings will be backed up first. Close WuWa and its injector before continuing.
recordUnavailable: The selected capture source is not included in this package. Choose an available source or repair the package.
connectionRequired: Reconnect using the recovery card to continue.
connectionRetryInfo: The launcher connection was interrupted. Retry here; your installed files and settings are kept.
launcherConflict: An older launcher is still running in the background. Open it, or stop its helper and connect this version below. Switching is blocked while the game, injector or a recording is active.
switchLauncher: Stop old launcher & use this version
launcherRecovered: Connected to this version. You can now choose a runtime or launch.
alreadyOpen: WuWa VR is already open. Windows could not bring it forward; select its taskbar button or close that window before opening another copy.
gameChoiceUnconfirmed: The helper did not confirm your new game launcher. The choice is saved for retry.
controllerIntro: Check what Windows exposes to this launcher, even before installing VR. This snapshot does not test button mappings or prove what the game can see.
controllerOnlyHelp: Wake or reconnect your controller, then Refresh. If no slot is connected, use the HidHide and application-rule results to review which intended input is visible. A virtual controller may also occupy a slot; do not disable devices based on these counts alone.
controllerTreadmillHelp: Check your intended physical-controller → Reality Runner → virtual-controller route. Both physical and virtual inputs can be hidden, and app rules determine who sees them. Review Reality Runner and HidHide together before making changes; a running helper or saved rule does not confirm correct routing.
controllerPrivacy: Read-only. No settings, processes or devices are changed. The copied report excludes usernames, full paths and device serials. Nothing is uploaded.
controllerNotChecked: Not checked yet. Select Refresh to read the current state.
controllerCheckingHint: Reading Windows XInput slots and optional HidHide information. You can keep using the launcher.
controllerComplete: Snapshot ready — review visibility and the notes below.
controllerTimedOut: The check timed out. No settings were changed. Refresh to try again.
controllerFailed: The check could not finish. No settings were changed. Refresh to try again.
controllerCopied: Redacted controller report copied. Nothing was uploaded.
controllerCopyFailed: The clipboard is unavailable. Select the report text to copy, or try Copy report again.
controllerSlotsHint: XInput slots are 0–3. A connected slot may represent a physical or virtual controller; its identity and in-game input are not established here.
controllerRuleKinds: Rule hints — Xbox-compatible: {0} · Bluetooth: {1} · Explicitly virtual: {2}
controllerRulesHint: Saved rules are not counts of currently connected devices. Xbox compatibility does not distinguish physical from virtual. A matching game filename does not prove the rule points to your current game path.
controllerFindingXInputUnavailable: Windows XInput could not be queried; controller visibility is unknown.
controllerFindingNone: No connected XInput slot is visible to this launcher. Disconnection, a non-XInput device or HidHide access rules are possible causes; this does not prove a broken controller.
controllerFindingProbe: Some XInput queries failed. Treat unreadable slots as unknown.
controllerFindingHiding: HidHide cloaking is active. Application rules can change which inputs each process sees.
controllerFindingGameRule: No recognized game-filename rule was returned. Review application rules and inverse mode; this alone does not prove the game is blocked.
controllerFindingInverse: Inverse application rules are enabled; listed and unlisted applications have reversed visibility rules.
controllerFindingIncomplete: HidHide information is incomplete; missing details remain unknown.
controllerFindingVisibility: This launcher, Reality Runner, UEVR and WuWa can have different XInput visibility. A launcher snapshot cannot certify the full input route.
controllerFindingHelpersIncomplete: Related-process information is incomplete; an unobserved helper is not confirmed stopped.
troubleshootingIntro: Controller visibility, launch diagnostics and repair when you need them. Recording and advanced tools are in Developer tools.
selectedVersionAction: Choose a different version here, confirm compatibility, then use the main button below to install it.
installConsent: My game matches this version and I accept the account risk shown above.
launcherPortable: Install with Setup.exe for app updates
launcherUpdateOffline: Launcher update check unavailable. Try again later.
launcherRestartIdle: Close WuWa and its injector; finish any recording or operation before restarting.
launcherRestartConfirm: Restart the launcher to install the downloaded update? WuWa, its injector, recordings and helper operations must be idle. Your settings and installed mod versions will be kept.
